verdict.rationale: Belvo publishes an OpenAPI spec page covering its data products (belvo-docs-14, belvo-docs-16). It also ships a dedicated Enrichment API (incomes, recurring expenses, risk insights, employment metrics) that gives an automated workflow pre-derived signals rather than raw text to parse (belvo-docs-15). Structured list endpoints with pagination and link filtering (belvo-docs-12, belvo-docs-13) and community praise that the API 'looks very clean' (belvo-comm-7) support the clean structured-data part of the story. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of JSON response formats and field-level schemas, a machine-readable OpenAPI file at a standard path (probes 404'd), and hands-on corroboration that enrichment output needs no heuristic parsing.
